title: Mix each token's features with one learned projection
description: A quick reference for the feature-projection, shape, and parameter-sharing terms used here.

terms.definition: A shared feature projection applied independently at every leading position.
A trainable matrix transformation mapping input features into output features.
The final-axis size expected by the layer's weight matrix.
The final-axis size created by the layer's projection.
Batch, sequence, or other position axes preserved by projection.
The shared trainable coefficients mixing every input feature into outputs.
An optional trainable output vector added at every leading position.
A matrix transformation followed by addition of a fixed or trainable bias vector.
Reusing one weight and bias across all independent token positions.
A projection that omits the additive bias parameter entirely.
